skill.summary: Download and install skills from ClawHub (https://clawhub.ai). Use when user wants to browse, search, or download skills from the ClawHub skill registry.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Improved documentation for searching, downloading, and installing skills from ClawHub.
- Added example user prompts and corresponding commands.
- Detailed the API endpoints used for skill search and download.
- Clarified command usage for skill listing, searching, and installation by both slug and URL.
